$comment: Single source of truth for the immutable refs that ci.yml and release.yml pin each sibling backend checkout to (§17 pin B). Each pinned commit CONTAINS the committed contract artifacts the gen:* drivers regenerate from: docs/schema.json, docs/flows.json, docs/errors.json, docs/capabilities.json (+ pyproject.toml for the manifest backend-version pin). Bumping a pin is a deliberate PR after the backend releases a new contract — never float main. Procedure: CONTRIBUTING.md, section 'Contract pins'. 2026-07-16: bumped to the v1-canon-sweep release tags (§60, api-versioning.md) — auth v0.5.8, notifications v0.3.8, profiles v0.3.13, billing v0.4.11, workspaces v0.4.2, calendar v0.3.4, recordings v0.3.2; all contracts now carry /<mod>/api/v1/ paths; react gen:* artifacts regenerated against these refs in the same change.

stapel-auth.note: release v0.12.0 — org-program security-harden primitives (W2+W3): login_grant (/grant/exchange/), first-login intermediates (FirstLoginChallengeResponse requires=password_change|mfa_enroll), /password/forced-change/, /mfa/enroll/exchange/ (enroll-only limited session), tokens on TOTP-confirm/passkey-complete for the enroll upgrade, auth.first_login flow. Pairs with @stapel/auth-react 0.9.0. Pin+regen bumped together (the discipline whose absence caused the earlier gen:check drift).

stapel-profiles.note: release v0.9.0 — POST /batch (many public profiles in one request, #111): the answer splits `profiles` from `missing`, so "no profile row" stays a normal state instead of a per-id 404. Plus the guest-surface naming sweep (#168). Pairs with @stapel/profiles-react 0.14.0's useProfilesBatch. Pin+regen bumped together.

stapel-workspaces.note: release v0.19.0 — roster-side name edit, on stapel-profiles' name canon. PATCH /{ws}/members/{user_id}/name writes the CANONICAL name (stapel-profiles' Profile.display_name through the in-process profiles seam, which also publishes profile.changed), NOT WorkspaceMember.display_name_hint — the hint goes dark the moment a real profile exists, so writing it would produce a correction only the roster shows. PATCH /{ws}/invitations/{invitation_id}/name is the same correction one step earlier, on a still-pending invitation's display_name_hint (before it, the only fix for a typo in an invitee's name was revoke-and-re-invite, which re-mails the person). Both on capability members.role.change (not members.invite: the hint IS the member's name after acceptance, so splitting them would let a role fix a name that reverts), both ANONYMOUS_DENIED, only an owner may rename an owner. Validation is stapel-profiles' validate_display_name verbatim — the four borrowed keys error.400.display_name_{too_short,forbidden_chars,invisible_chars,emoji} are re-declared here so this module's contract is honest; over-length is the fleet-standard error.400.field.max_length {field,max_length}, no bespoke code. Without stapel-profiles in the process the member endpoint answers error.503.profiles_unavailable rather than a 200 over a write that did not happen. Pairs with @stapel/workspaces-react 0.10.0's useRenameMember / useRenameInvitation. Pin+regen bumped together. Still standing from v0.18.0 and unchanged here: GET /instance (InstanceShapeResponse / STREET_LANDING_MODE), GET /'s is_guest + default_workspace_id, settings.security.capability_levels.
